en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of Native American riders on horseback in traditional dress, including feathered headdresses, blankets, and beadwork. They are posed in a line facing the camera on open ground with trees in the background, with two standing figures at the edges. The photograph is bordered like an old print and has a faint, reversed handwritten identifier along the top edge.
